desc:
💥 Welcome to +1 Super Saiyan Destruction!

How to play:
💥 DESTROY the map with punches, Ki Blasts and giant BEAMS!
🥊 TRAIN at punching bags to get even STRONGER!
⚡ EVOLVE into new forms to deal MORE damage! There are 8 forms per fighter, can you max them all?
🦸 Unlock 3 LEGENDARY fighters, each with their own special moves!
⬆️ Upgrade your moves to make BIGGER explosions and earn MORE!
🔄️ Rebirth to keep stacking your multipliers, and become a TOP PLAYER!
🌍 New maps every round, destroy it all before time runs out!
🎁 Free gifts + earn power even while you're OFFLINE!

👍 LIKE GAME AND JOIN GROUP FOR MORE UPDATES + A FREE REWARD!! 👍
